info.name: METT-ElasticSearch-Extended
info.description:
Dataset maintenance queries against a METT Elasticsearch **release set**.

**Host:** `{{mett-elasticsearch-current}}` from the Postman environment (local / dev / prod files in `postman/`).

**Auth:** collection-level Basic `{{mett-elasticsearch-username}}` / `{{mett-elasticsearch-pass}}` — same secret-in-environment pattern as METT-DataPortal's `{{bearer-token-current}}`. Leave those env values empty in git; fill them in Postman.

**Indexes:** collection variables `index-*` default to `mett-{{mett-release}}-{family}`. Change `mett-release` or override a single `index-*` (legacy `feature_index`, or a concrete `mett-v1-g001-features`).

Use **METT-ElasticSearch** for smoke expected-totals. This collection is for inventory, species visibility, and ingest quality checks.

Species enable/disable writes Elasticsearch only; restart the API so the in-memory species registry reloads.

item.name: Species visibility

request.description: Portal APIs only return `enabled=true`. This lists every species document.
Species `_id` is the acronym. Defaults to `species_acronym_toggle` so BU/PV are not used for enable/disable tests.

Sets `enabled=true` on one species document. This does **not** refresh the Django in-memory species registry; restart the API (or call the portal enable endpoint if available) after changing visibility.
Sets `enabled=false` on `{{species_acronym_toggle}}`.
Enables every acronym in `species_acronyms_bulk` (comma-separated). Does not touch BU/PV unless those acronyms are in the list.
Disables every acronym in `species_acronyms_bulk`.

item.description: Toggle `enabled` on species documents. Single updates use `species_acronym_toggle`; bulk updates use `species_acronyms_bulk`.
